title: Dynamic Memory-enhanced Pattern Relevance Prediction for Long-tailed Graph Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.27141v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-tailed graph classification (LTGC) is common in real-world graph datasets, where a few large head graphs provide rich structural information while many smaller tail graphs offer fewer structural cues, making it harder to learn discriminative representations for tail graphs. To address this size-based imbalance, we propose Dynamic Memory-enhanced Pattern Relevance Prediction (DMPRP), which transfers structural patterns from head graphs to tail graphs. Given a graph representation as a query, a dynamic expert memory module inspired by Knowledge-diverse Experts (KDEX) generates a residual vector that augments the original representation. We train the module using co-occurrence triplets sampled from head graphs at the node, rooted subgraph, and random-walk neighborhood levels. translated_title: 面向长尾图分类的动态记忆增强模式相关性预测
translated_abstract: 长尾图分类在真实世界的图数据集中十分常见，其中少量较大的头部图提供丰富的结构信息，而大量较小的尾部图提供的结构线索较少，这使得为尾部图学习判别性表示变得更加困难。为了解决这种基于规模的不平衡问题，我们提出了动态记忆增强模式相关性预测（DMPRP），该方法将结构模式从头图迁移到尾部图。给定一个图表示作为查询，一个受知识多样专家启发的动态专家记忆模块生成一个残差向量来增强原始表示。我们使用从头图在节点、根子图和随机游走邻域层面采样的共现三元组来训练该模块。在五个图分类基准上的实验表明，DMPRP 提升了尾部类的性能，消融研究表明专家模块和随机游走（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 提出DMPRP方法，通过动态专家记忆模块将头部图的结构模式迁移到尾部图，从而有效提升长尾图分类任务中尾部类的性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes DMPRP, which transfers structural patterns from head graphs to tail graphs via a dynamic expert memory module, effectively improving tail-class performance in long-tailed graph classification.
